title: Ukraine shoots down Russian jet-powered Geran drone with combat laser for first time – video
excerpt: Ukraine has shot down a Russian jet-powered Geran drone with a Blysk combat laser for the first time while defending critical infrastructure, an expert has reported.
content_html:
A Russian jet-powered Geran-type drone has been shot down with a combat laser in Ukraine for the first time.

Source: Serhii "Flash" Beskrestnov, a radio technology expert and adviser to the president of Ukraine

Details: According to Beskrestnov, the drone was hit by a Blysk laser air defence system developed by the Ukrainian company Carmine Sky. The system was being used to protect a critical infrastructure facility. Beskrestnov said this is the first confirmed downing of a jet-powered Geran by a combat laser.

Advertisement:

Quote: "Several companies in Ukraine are working on developing lasers for air defence. Laser technologies are very complex and expensive, so it is gratifying when someone has good news. At the moment it is too early to talk about mass-producing lasers. Trials are underway, and lasers are protecting critical infrastructure facilities during these trials."

Details: According to Beskrestnov, anti-drone laser systems are being developed within a private air defence project and the Brave1 defence tech cluster, among other initiatives.

Background:

  • Ukraine's General Staff recently reported that during October 2026, Ukraine's defence forces downed or jammed 4,859 of the 6,473 Shahed-type strike drones that Russia used to attack Ukraine.
  • The Ukrainian company SpaceRay has developed the SpaceRay SA handheld tracking and targeting system for mobile air defence fire groups, which uses laser designation to engage targets.
